description: This file defines authentication-related API routes for user registration, login, and current user profile retrieval using FastAPI. It includes route handlers that interact with services and database sessions to handle user data and authentication tokens.

classes.name: UserResponse
classes.description: Schema representing user data returned in responses.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Schema for login request payload containing email and password.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Schema for registration request payload containing email and password.

methods.name: register_user( payload: RegisterRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Handles user registration by calling the auth service and returning the created user response.

methods.name: login( payload: LoginRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Handles user login, verifies credentials, and returns access token.

methods.name: get_me( user_id: Annotated[int, Depends(get_current_user_id)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's profile based on the provided token.
